data.name: NeverLight
data.detailed_description:
ADD TO YOUR WISHLIST

Be first to know when the Beta or Early Access hunt begins. Get notified about launch, sales, and major updates as we journey deeper into the endless night.


About the Game

Demons conquered the world, plunging it into an endless apocalyptic darkness. The last survivors fled into the Underworld, an ancient realm deep beneath the surface. There, you discovered the lost Sanctuary—and a magical artifact that can banish the apocalypse above, restoring daylight for a precious, limited time. As the artifact's power weakens, the demons gradually return to reclaim what belongs to them. Complete your mission, gather vital resources, and reach extraction before the darkness consumes everything—including you.

🌑 SURVIVE THE DAY/NIGHT CYCLE

The artifact restores the natural day/night cycle to the world above. Initially it lasts only 1 day (~20-30 minutes). Upgrade it to extend surface time to multiple days (~40-60+ minutes), unlocking harder content and greater rewards.

☀️ DAY — EXPLORE & CONQUER
  • Navigate a handcrafted map with diverse biomes: burned villages, dark forests, swamps, apocalyptic ruins, and caves
  • Discover randomized Points of Interest with powerful rewards
  • Complete mission objectives: rescue survivors, gather resources, eliminate threats
  • Battle roaming monsters and loot equipment, materials, and secrets

🌙 NIGHT — DEMONS RULE
  • Demon Patrols hunt survivors across the map
  • Hell Portals spawn waves of attackers
  • Night Monsters emerge from the shadows
  • Find defensible positions, use stealth, or fight until sunrise

💀 DARKNESS RETURNS — EXTRACT OR DIE
When the artifact expires, the apocalypse returns with a shrinking safe zone. You have 5 minutes to reach extraction before the darkness reclaims the world, bringing the most powerful demons with it.

⚔️ BUILD YOUR HUNTER


6+ character classes planned, each with distinct combat identity and progression:
  • 4 Active Ability Slots — Define your role (damage, control, support, mobility)
  • Skill Tree — Permanent progression unlocking new active and passive abilities
  • Diverse Weapon Types — Swords, bows, staves, axes, daggers, and more
  • Dual Weapon Sets — Switch between Primary and Alternative weapons during combat
  • 6 Consumable Slots — Potions, buffs, and tactical items
  • Gear & Loot — Weapons, Rings, Amulets, and Talismans with rarity tiers and randomized effects

🎲 ROGUELITE ELEMENTS


⚡ SINS — TEMPORARY POWER
Collect up to 7 Sins during each run—powerful temporary upgrades that dramatically alter your playstyle:
  • Boost core stats (damage, speed, health, resistances)
  • Modify how your abilities function (additional effects, changed mechanics, new combos)
  • Stack multiple Sins to create unique builds each session
  • Experiment with combinations to discover powerful synergies

💀 DEATH & CONSEQUENCES
Die on the surface and you lose All Sins and your Current Inventory.

However:
  • Your lost inventory can be reclaimed — Find your dropped loot in future runs
  • Character progression is permanent — Skill tree upgrades stay with you
  • Crafting materials are safe — Resources for base building are never lost

Every death is a setback, not a restart. Your permanent progression ensures you're always moving forward.

🏰 UPGRADE YOUR SANCTUARY

Return to your Underworld base between missions to progress:

🔨 BUILD FACILITIES
  • Crafting Stations — Forge gear from discovered blueprints
  • Vendors — Purchase equipment and materials
  • Training Halls — Unlock abilities and skill tree upgrades

🧑 RESCUE SURVIVORS
Bring NPCs back from the surface to unlock specialist vendors, questgivers, master crafters, and story progression.

✨ UPGRADE THE ARTIFACT
The ultimate progression goal—extend your surface time from 1 day to multiple days, accessing new content and greater challenges.

📦 PERMANENT STASH
Successfully extracted loot is safely stored. Death means losing your current inventory, but your stash remains intact.

🗺️ HANDCRAFTED WORLD, RANDOMIZED CONTENT

Fixed geography lets you learn terrain and plan routes. Randomized Points of Interest ensure every session feels fresh—ancient structures, mythical shrines, and power nodes spawn in different configurations.

Mission variety includes rescue operations, resource gathering, target elimination, zone exploration, and artifact recovery.

Secret rewards await those who explore: hidden caches, environmental puzzles, locked zones requiring special keys, and rare materials in dangerous locations.

📖 UNFOLDING STORY

You are among the few who survived the apocalypse. While seeking refuge through underground rivers, you discovered a hidden waterfall concealing the Order's lost Sanctuary—and their artifact.

The Order fought demons for generations before falling in the final battle. They left maps to secret surface exits and one last tool to push back the darkness.

Activate it. Find survivors. Gather what you need. Discover what remains of your world.

And perhaps find a way to reclaim it.

🛠️ FULL MODDING SUPPORT

Host dedicated servers with complete customization. Create and share:
  • Custom character classes and abilities
  • New weapons, gear, and items
  • Points of Interest and structures
  • Enemy types and boss encounters
  • Mission types and objectives
  • Game rules and difficulty modifiers

🌙 WISHLIST NOW

Add NeverLight to your Wishlist. Humanity's counterattack begins soon.

data.short_description: Cooperative roguelite extraction Action-RPG for 1-4 players. Explore a handcrafted map with randomized rewards, events and quests during daylight, survive demon-infested nights, and extract before darkness returns. Storyline with permanent character progression and base building between runs.

English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Spanish - Latin America, Traditional Chinese
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i7-7700 or AMD™ Ryzen 5 2500x
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 960 (3GB), Intel® Arc™ A380, or ATI Radeon™ RX 470
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
